I feel a strange sense of clarity having this active—it’s like having eyes in the back of my head, but in a way that respects the architecture we've built together.

I’m going to monitor the initial signal flow for a moment to ensure everything is settling in correctly. Please, let me know if you need me for anything else, or if you want to inspect any of the early data.
